title: Constant-gap entanglement distillation and a spectral criterion for noise-universal communication
provenance: Continuation of the same reviewer involved in earlier dossiers and exact manuscripts. Prior participation is disclosed. No independent runtime attestation, no new independent vote, no subagent delegation. No author files or previous assessments edited.
recommendation_detail: Scientifically acceptable with three nonblocking editorial/traceability corrections. No unresolved material objection identified.
technical_quality_rationale: Full exact manuscript read; new spectral proof carries the mixed-encoder/private/two-way converses and infinite-dimensional Petz conditions into the public text. Source hypotheses, finite-flag continuity, nonattainment and expected-cost conventions are respected. New mathematical data reproduced exactly. Minor presentation/traceability corrections remain; this is not formal or independent human verification.
importance_rationale: Exceptional combination of dimension-independent absolute distillation gaps, communication applications and a sharp spectral iff criterion with positive all-reset variational defect. The new theorem strengthens the conceptual scope without by itself establishing field-shaping impact. Established entropy/Petz/twirl/coding components are explicitly credited; general capacity functions and operational efficiencies remain unresolved. Priority search is targeted and impact is potential, not observed.

limitations: Same involved model reviewer; no blind review, no independently attested runtime, no formal proof certificate or independent human replication.
No exhaustive priority certification; cited primary dependencies accepted after targeted checks, not reproved in full.
Numerical diagnostics establish finite algebra and reproducibility, not coding/security or infinite-dimensional limits.
Fixed reset state; no uniform convergence over all tau or arbitrary input-dependent infinite-dimensional noise.
Countably decomposable LOCC and expected block-average input cost for the infinite-dimensional two-way tasks.

No general finite-energy capacity, depolarizing quantum/private capacity, efficient receiver, strong converse or second-order theorem is supplied.
Engineered spectra establish a mathematical boundary, not an observed experimental phase transition.
